state.persona: Parent planning a February or Christmas ski week for two adults and two kids (ages matter for lessons and lift tickets), comparing Colorado Rockies vs Swiss Alps, wants to coordinate with a second family. Not technical; does not know what Supabase or 'membership service' means.
state.job_to_be_done: Pick a resort and week that works for my family, gather what I need to decide, and get it in front of the other family.
state.workflow_state: Arrived from the home page 'Start a family ski trip' link at /trips?season=winter&interest=ski. Has filled every field of the form (Swiss Alps, 13-20 Feb 2027, Atlanta (ATL), 2 adults, 2 children, near the lifts, $900/night).
visible_left_column: Begin with two regions and the shape of your trip. Create a Circle, send its link to the other family, then use the private conversation to compare towns and stays.
01 Choose a window and what your family needs.
02 Share the Circle link with your friend.
03 Approve their request, then shortlist together.

The Circle name, region, and dates are visible to signed-in members. Household details and budget are posted only to its accepted-member conversation. A link is an invitation to request access, not automatic entry.
